title: Analysis code for: Splice-Event and Gene-Abundance Layers Are Independent and Differ in Human Asthma Relevance
description: Analysis scripts for gene-level and splice-event-level profiling of a chronic ovalbumin model of allergic airway inflammation, including splicing-factor and transcription-factor layer analysis, a novel-transcript annotation sensitivity check, cross-species mapping to GSE152004 and GSE158752, and receiver-operating-characteristic comparison of expression-derived and splice-derived signatures with DeLong testing, bootstrap confidence intervals and type-2 stratification.
